text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I can't believe this! Even after I cast my "success magic" on you, how can you still be this bad?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Good grief!
It's so much work having such an incompetent familiar.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Wh-What is it?
You don't have to look so down!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
~~gh, oh, honestly...!
Don't worry, I'm not going to fire my familiar,
so lift your head up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I'm kinda in the mood
for something sweet.
Buy me a treat and I'll forgive you for everything!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's head to the café!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
